description: Source code for the 3D sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing sensor data processing, conversion, and device initialization.

methods.name: shifted_q31_to_scaled_int64
methods.description: Converts a shifted Q31 fixed-point value to a scaled 64-bit integer.

methods.name: scaled_int64_to_shifted_q31
methods.description: Converts a scaled 64-bit integer to a shifted Q31 fixed-point value.

methods.name: accel_sensor_value_to_q31
methods.description: Converts sensor_value to Q31 format for accelerometer data.

methods.name: accel_q31_to_sensor_value
methods.description: Converts Q31 accelerometer data back to sensor_value.

methods.name: gyro_sensor_value_to_q31
methods.description: Converts sensor_value to Q31 format for gyroscope data.

methods.name: gyro_q31_to_sensor_value
methods.description: Converts Q31 gyroscope data back to sensor_value.

methods.name: phy_3d_sensor_init
methods.description: Initializes the 3D sensor device, setting custom sensor types.

methods.name: phy_3d_sensor_attr_set_hyst
methods.description: Sets hysteresis or slope threshold attribute for the sensor.

methods.name: phy_3d_sensor_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes, including hysteresis and others.

methods.name: phy_3d_sensor_submit
methods.description: Fetches sensor data, converts it, and submits it via RTIO.
